# Offline legacy DAVE compatibility

`run.py` builds a pre-migration peer from production source commit
`38e46b8f5ec694002ef515fbc2d8dc69297e4f5f` and a peer from the current worktree.
It uses pinned Rust 1.98.1, Python 3.12+, Git and cached Cargo dependencies:

```sh
python3 crates/discord-voice/tests/fixtures/legacy-dave/run.py
```

The peers use synthetic identities, a local delivery signer and JSON pipes capped
at 64 KiB per request/response. Each operation has a 30-second I/O deadline; a
timeout names the peer/operation and stops both children before cleanup. Each
offline Cargo build is capped at 30 minutes. Run
`python3 crates/discord-voice/tests/fixtures/legacy-dave/test_run.py` for the
stalled-peer cleanup regression. No network, account, audio device or private data is
used. Both creator/joiner roles must join, merge the creator's own commit, agree on
the epoch/privacy code, exchange encrypted synthetic Opus bytes in both directions,
and reject altered/replayed packets. This is wire-compatibility evidence, not a
cryptographic audit or proof of live Discord interoperability.

Legacy source is extracted into an automatically removed temporary workspace;
its vulnerable dependencies are used only for this explicit offline comparison.
They are not added to the application workspace, lockfile or distribution. Helper
build outputs live in `target/dave-interop/{legacy,current}`. The helper manifests
start from the corresponding production lockfile, then resolve only their smaller
standalone dependency graphs offline.

`key-package.bin` is an opcode-26 public key package for synthetic user 2/channel 3,
generated by the legacy peer. Its SHA-256 is
`b5efc8786b633ae278ff0e29f8ea03e25d2959222795feb237fdf70ce50b292d`.
No private signing or join key is retained. The ordinary voice regression test
validates this signed legacy package and merges its own resulting commit using the
new stack. `run.py` preserves the committed fixture; delete it explicitly to
regenerate a different public package. `interop.json` records the reviewed run.
